{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if there's any other column that might indicate test orders
# Look at the 'order_id' pattern or other clues
print("First 10 order_ids:")
print(sales['order_id'].head(10).values)

print("\nUnique values in 'channel':")
print(sales['channel'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in 'converted':")
print(sales['converted'].unique())

# Check if 'converted' is 0 for all test orders? But we don't know what test orders are.
# Check if revenue is zero for test orders? Let's see distribution of revenue.
print("\nRevenue distribution:")
print(sales['revenue'].describe())

# Check how many orders have zero revenue
zero_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'] == 0].shape[0]
total_orders = sales.shape[0]
print(f"\nNumber of orders with zero revenue: {zero_revenue} / {total_orders}")"}
